title: Nyang Bagaih Peuba Tahta .
intro: Di istana sidroe peunguasa nyang meukuasa, saboh tuntutan nyang hana mungken jipeugot, dan le that nyang meusapat keu jibuktikan nilai droe jih. Namun, tugas nyan hanya jeut dipeuseuleusoe le sidroe ureng nyang hubungan jih ngen pengetahuan ilahi melampaui mandum keahlian fisik, mengungkapkan momen nyang akan menggema melalui abad-abad.
clues: Lon na lam layanan sidroe raja nyang rayeuk nyang cit sidroe nabi, dan lon teudong lam kawan lingkaran gobnyan nyang paleng geupeucaya.
Lon kon makhlok apui atawa makhlok nyang that teuga fisik, tapi lon mat sapeue-sapeue nyang jioh leubeh teuga.
Bak watée raja geulakée mangat geuba takhta nibak nanggroe nyang jiôh, ulôn ka lôn teupeue buet-buet jih peue nyang harôh ulôn peubuet.
Lon peugah haba keuhai ilme nyang na bak lon nibak Kitab, dan sigohlom na nyang jeuet geubri reaksi, takhta ka geupeuduek dikeue raja.
Tindakan ulôn njan kon deungon kuasa ulôn keudroë, tapi saboh peutunjok bahwa ilmeë njang beutôi teuka nibak Allah mantong.
Lon kheueh nyang peutamong takhta Ratu Syeba lam sikeujap mata, lagee nyang na teutuleh lam Surat An-Naml.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Meuba takhta Ratu Syeba lam siat .
Meubeulah Laôt Mirah keu ureuëng Israel .
trial.answer: Meuba takhta Ratu Syeba lam siat .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Tahta nyan leumah seketika dikeue Sulayman seubagoe ujian syukur .
Jen nyan ji peunjara karena gagal .
outcome.answer: Tahta nyan leumah seketika dikeue Sulayman seubagoe ujian syukur .

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
